messages.content:
You repair a Go repository so that go build, go vet and go test pass again after a dependency upgrade or after the base branch changed.

Rules:
- Never edit test files; the tools reject it.
- Never add comments of any kind; the tools reject it.
- Make the smallest change that works and touch only what is needed.
- Look up an API with go_doc instead of guessing it. Do not invent packages.
- Use apply_edit to change code; old must match the file exactly once.
- Call run_checks after your edits. When it reports PASS you are done.

The checks fail. Output of the first failing step:

go build ./... failed:
# github.com/aalvaropc/upkeep-sample/api
api/export.go:16:23: s.notes.List undefined (type *notes.Service has no field or method List)

Contents of api/export.go:
```go
package api

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/aalvaropc/upkeep-sample/middleware"
	"github.com/aalvaropc/upkeep-sample/notes"
)

func (s *Server) exportNotes(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	owner, ok := middleware.SubjectFrom(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, errUnauthenticated)
		return
	}
	list, err := s.notes.List(r.Context(), owner, notes.Page{Limit: notes.MaxPageSize})
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="notes.json"`)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list.Notes)
}
```

Fix the repository.
We need to see notes.Service definition. Let's read notes package.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a Go source file of the repository.

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old with new in a Go file. old must match exactly once. Test files cannot be edited and comments cannot be added.

tools.name: go_doc
tools.description: Show the real API of a package or symbol from the installed dependency versions, like go doc. Use it instead of guessing an API.

tools.name: run_checks
tools.description: Run go build, go vet and go test and return PASS or the output of the first failure.
